A comparison of engagement across 3 attendee roles, with attendance format as a second factor and age as a covariate. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (One-way ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis test, Two-way ANOVA, Analysis of covariance (ANCOVA)) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `multi_group`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("multi_group")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Do the 3 attendee roles differ in sessions attended? | One-way ANOVA | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| The same question without assuming normality. | Kruskal-Wallis test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Do role and format both matter? | Two-way ANOVA | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Does the role difference survive adjusting for age? | Analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
